title: JavaScript Basics Learning Check
description: A live check-in after the JavaScript Basics workshop.

questions.prompt: Which keyword declares a variable you can reassign later?
questions.explanation: let declares a reassignable, block-scoped variable. const can't be reassigned.

questions.prompt: How do you print a message to the console in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: console.log() writes output to the console — handy for checking your work.

questions.prompt: What is the result of "3" + 4 in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: A string + a number concatenates: "3" + 4 becomes the string "34".

questions.prompt: Which of these is a boolean value?
questions.explanation: true (without quotes) is a boolean. "true" is a string and 1 is a number.

questions.prompt: To run basics-fixme.js with Node.js, which command do you use?
questions.explanation: node <filename> runs a JavaScript file with Node.js.
